response.sql:
WITH member_attendance AS (
    SELECT
        m.member_id,
        m.position,
        COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m
      ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
), total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance
)
SELECT
    ma.member_id,
    ma.position,
    ma.attendance_count,
    1.0 * ma.attendance_count / NULLIF(t.attendance_count, 0) AS attendance_share
FROM member_attendance AS ma
CROSS JOIN total AS t
ORDER BY attendance_share DESC, ma.member_id
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Share of total attendance means each member's attendance count divided by all rows in attendance, including any attendance rows that do not match a member. Members with no attendance are omitted.
